clue.text: Having considered the matter offers footnote

definitions.meaning: first meaning, read as two words: once you have thought, you are past the thinking stage
second meaning: something added later as an extra remark

explanation.surface: Someone who has weighed things up adds a note at the bottom of the page.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a cryptic split: 'after thought' is the state of having considered the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A footnote is a supplementary remark, which is just what an idea added later amounts to.

clue.text: Awful batting? Time for teasing

parts.note: awful means bad
a side that is batting in cricket is in
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A poor cricket innings earns the player some mockery from teammates.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batting side is said to be 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful, witty banter, the gentle mockery that teasing describes.

clue.text: Saint with the old eyelid problem

parts.note: standard abbreviation for saint
ye is an archaic form of the

explanation.surface: A holy man of old suffered from a sore eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the edge of an eyelid, a common minor ailment.

clue.text: Very soggy duck in Johannesburg township

parts.note: so means very, as in 'so tired'
soggy means wet
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so the zero-shaped letter

explanation.surface: A rain-soaked waterbird is spotted in a South African township.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a cricket score of zero, hence O.
explanation.definitionFit: Soweto is the large urban area to the south-west of Johannesburg, famous from the 1976 uprising.

clue.text: Soldiers surrounding sinister eastern islands

indicators.note: surrounding means going all round, so the first item encloses what follows

parts.note: soldier ants, so ants can be soldiers
ill as in ill omen, evil or threatening
standard abbreviation for eastern

explanation.surface: Troops are deployed around some menacing islands in the east.
explanation.walkthrough: Soldier ants are a caste of ant that defends the colony, which is why 'Soldiers' can stand for ants.
explanation.definitionFit: The Antilles are the Caribbean island chains, Greater and Lesser, so a group of islands.

clue.text: One is caging black bird

indicators.note: to cage something is to shut it inside, so one part holds the other

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
taken as written
abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone keeps a dark-feathered bird in a cage.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-legged wading bird with a curved bill, sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Achievement to hold small banquet

indicators.note: holding something means keeping it within, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a feat is an achievement
standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Hosting a modest banquet counts as quite an accomplishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A feast is a large celebratory meal, the same thing as a banquet.

clue.text: Do we expect to be moved by this anthology?

definitions.text: Do we expect to be moved by this
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a passenger vehicle that carries people from place to place, the old full name of a bus
second meaning: a volume collecting several works together

explanation.surface: A reader wonders whether a collection of writing will stir the emotions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moved' looks emotional, but it means physically transported, as by a public vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: An omnibus edition gathers several works into a single volume, which is what an anthology is.

clue.text: Cooked alternative to ploughman's lunch?

parts.note: surface reading: a hot pub dish to choose instead of the cold plate of bread, cheese and pickle; setter's reading: another rural worker in place of the ploughman, whose name goes with a baked dish

explanation.surface: A pub-goer wants something hot instead of the usual cold lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: A ploughman's lunch is a British pub meal of bread, cheese and pickle; the answer swaps in a different farm worker and a hot dish of mince topped with mashed potato.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a baked dish of minced lamb under potato, named for a countryside worker as the cold plate is.

clue.text: Sinister look from Levi troubled detective

indicators.note: something troubled is disturbed, so these letters are thrown out of order

parts.note: the name, taken as written before rearranging
a private eye is a detective

explanation.surface: A worried detective called Levi casts a menacing glance.
explanation.definitionFit: The evil eye is a malevolent stare believed to bring bad luck, a sinister look indeed.

clue.text: Lives with girl: shares perhaps?

parts.note: to be, to live, as in 'he is no more'
a common girl's name

explanation.surface: A man lives with his girlfriend and wonders whether they share everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A company makes a share issue when it offers stock, so shares are an example of an issue.

clue.text: Fungus hateful people saw for instance

parts.note: a toad is a contemptible person
a saw is an example of a tool

explanation.surface: Nasty folk cut down a mushroom with a saw.
explanation.definitionFit: A toadstool is a mushroom-like growth, typically inedible, so a kind of fungus.

clue.text: Doctor Sara with duty for twenty-four period

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are altered in order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Doctor Sara is on call for a full day and night shift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like Sara's title, but it is the instruction to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturday is one day of the week, a span of twenty-four hours.

clue.text: This spewed out when hot?

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A riddle about what a volcano throws out when it is hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is the powdery debris that volcanoes and fires throw up into the air.

clue.text: Barker's excellent ginger beer

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the one written as the letter I
ginger hair is red
ale is a kind of beer

explanation.surface: Someone named Barker brews a fine ginger beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barker' looks like a surname but is a dog, something that barks.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is a large terrier breed, and any dog is something that barks.

clue.text: Duke appearing in Old English poem

indicators.note: showing up inside something means being placed within it

parts.note: standard abbreviation for Old English
abbreviation for duke

explanation.surface: A nobleman features in an early English poem.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyric poem, usually addressed to a person or thing in an elevated style.

clue.text: Finance officer's rearrest arranged outside university

indicators.note: being outside something means wrapping around it, so the rearranged word encloses the other part
arranging puts things into a new order, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: taken as written before rearranging
standard abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: An official's second arrest is arranged off campus.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer manages the money of a club, company or government, so is a finance officer.

clue.text: Cake is miracle prepared without topping

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, worked into a new form, so the letters are reordered
losing its topping means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A baker boasts that a cake is a miracle once ready, even without icing.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first letter of the word first, then rearrange the remaining six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An eclair is a finger of choux pastry filled with cream and iced, a small cake.

clue.text: Person with no future an individual in Greece

indicators.note: in places the first part within the second

parts.note: GR is the international code for Greece
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A lone man in Greece has no prospects.
explanation.definitionFit: A goner is someone doomed or past saving, a person whose future has run out.

clue.text: No American shows common sense

parts.note: taken as written
the US, the United States

explanation.surface: A remark that Americans display no practical judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: Nous is an informal British word for practical intelligence, borrowed from Greek for mind.

clue.text: Dodgy old ruse used in place of cure

indicators.note: something dodgy is unreliable or crooked, so the letters come out twisted

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A shady old trick is used to pass off a phony medical remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Lourdes in south-west France is a pilgrimage site where miraculous healing is said to occur.

clue.text: Language doctor up between two universities

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means reading the word from bottom to top, back to front
placed between two things means set inside them, one on each side

parts.note: U is the standard abbreviation for university, so two of them
standard abbreviation for doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor moves up between posts at two universities, learning a language.
explanation.walkthrough: The two universities split, one on each side of the turned-round doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan, also widely spoken in India.

clue.text: Outside of Tours a friend there gives wave

indicators.note: the outside of a word is its first and last letters only

parts.note: the French city's name, keeping only its edges
'there' means in France, where 'a friend' is un ami

explanation.surface: Someone waves at a friend outside the French city of Tours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'There' points back to Tours: put 'a friend' into French.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsunami is a huge sea wave caused by an earthquake or undersea upheaval.

clue.text: Food counter stocking hearts in metropolis

indicators.note: a counter stocking goods keeps them within, so one part holds the other

parts.note: a deli, or delicatessen, sells food over a counter
abbreviation for hearts, the card suit

explanation.surface: A city deli sells heart-shaped treats.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is India's vast capital territory, a metropolis of over twenty million people.
